items.title: Remove from history (video menu)
items.smarttube: Context-menu action on History items: removes the video from YouTube history via feedback token and drops the local resume state.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: local_catalog() 'local:video:%u:forget' -> tube_remove_history(), label "Remove from local history"
native/tube_provider.c: g_account_actions {"history_remove","Remove from YouTube history"} with history_remove_cursor scope/deadline checks
items.notes: Local and account removal are two separate actions; SmartTube does both in one. Live-account acceptance pending.

items.title: Main browse screen / sidebar
items.smarttube: Sidebar of enable-able, reorderable sections (rows/grids/multi-grid), boot section, pinned items, password-locked sections, pagination on scroll, long-press menus for cards and sections, channel sorting and playlists row/grid style.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: local_catalog() root folders (discover, history, favorites, queue, subscriptions, blocked-channels, settings) and 'discover' / 'library' folders
native/tube_provider.c: catalog() paged 'library:*' and 'section:*' requests with g_library_cursors
gaps: No Shorts, Trending, Kids, Notifications, My videos or account Channels sections
Sections are a fixed two-level folder tree (Discover > ...), not a flat sidebar; no per-section enable/disable, reorder (move up/down) or boot-section choice
No pinned playlists/channels in the sidebar
No section long-press menu (refresh, unpin, move, rename, mark all channels watched)
No channel-section sorting (new content / name / last viewed) and no playlists rows-vs-grid style
No password-protected sections
items.notes: Individual gaps are tracked as extra.Section.* / extra.Menu.* items below.

items.title: Channel page
items.smarttube: Opens a channel as multiple rows (uploads, playlists, live, shorts, etc.) with pagination, in-channel search bar, sort options and card context menu; reachable from any video via Open channel.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: valid_catalog_id() accepts 'channel:UC...'; 'subscriptions' folder emits 'channel:%.24s' rows
gaps: Channel shows only the uploads list; no rows/tabs for playlists, live streams, Shorts, releases or featured shelves
No in-channel search (ChannelPresenter.onSearchSubmit) and no channel sort options (onSearchSettingsClicked)
A channel can only be opened from locally followed channels or by typing channel:<id>; no Open channel action from a video (see extra.Menu.OpenChannel)
Channel results are not returned by search, so channels cannot be discovered by name

items.title: Playlist / uploads grid
items.smarttube: Opens a playlist or a channel's uploads as a paged grid, with card context menu; also used to resolve a group (first item, playlist id) for other actions.
gaps: No way to open the containing playlist or the channel uploads from a video card (Open playlist / Open channel uploads actions absent)
No subscribed-channel uploads entry with new-content marker (Channels section missing)
items.notes: The grid itself, pagination and occurrence-preserving playback context are implemented.

items.title: Video details screen
items.smarttube: Stub presenter that opens a DetailsView for a video (legacy Leanback details page).
gaps: No video details screen (title, channel, full description, stats) before playback
items.notes: Low priority: the SmartTube presenter is a 38-line stub that is hardly reachable in the UI. Covered in practice by extra.Menu.OpenDescription.

items.title: Search screen
items.smarttube: Query search with paged result groups, search tags (suggestions + history) with long-press remove/clear, voice search, filter dialog (upload date, duration, type, features, sort), play-first-result mode.
ps5_evidence: companion/prosperotube/catalog.py: page_for() ytsearch paging, URL / video: / channel: / playlist: forms
gaps: No search suggestions / autocomplete tags
No search history (recent queries, remove one, clear all)
No search filters or sort order
Search results contain videos and playlists only; channel results are dropped
No play-first-result mode (startPlay)
items.notes: See extra.Search.* for the breakdown.

items.title: Playback entry point
items.smarttube: Opens a video (optionally incognito / at a time / finish-on-end), forwards player events to controllers, tracks background/PIP state, exposes setPosition and suggestion click/long-click.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: resolve(), chosen(), progress() (resume position, played flag)
gaps: No incognito open (video.incognito suppressing history/progress)
No background playback while browsing with a Return to background video action (isRunningInBackground)
No open-at-time entry (openVideo(videoId, finishOnEnded, timeMs)) from links such as ?t=
items.notes: Player-controller behaviour is outside this scope; only the presenter-level entry points were assessed. PIP is Android-only.

items.title: Embedded web browser
items.smarttube: Loads an arbitrary URL in an Android WebView activity.
items.notes: Android WebView activity; the PS5 title has no embeddable web view and sign-in uses the device-code flow instead.

items.title: Home section
items.smarttube: Home recommendations as rows, with pagination and watched-suggestion filtering.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: CATALOG_FOLDER('library:home', "Home recommendations") and library 'home' action
items.notes: Lives under Discover rather than as the boot section; needs the companion library worker. Other Home layouts are listed as open in docs/STATUS.md.

items.title: Shorts section
items.smarttube: Dedicated Shorts grid (getShortsObserve) with paging.
gaps: No Shorts feed in the worker (topic_catalog.mjs sections = music, gaming, news, sports, live, movies)
No native 'section:shorts' folder; only /shorts/ URLs are accepted in search

items.title: Trending section
items.smarttube: Trending rows (getTrendingObserve).
gaps: No trending browse in companion/innertube/topic_catalog.mjs and no native folder
items.notes: Would reuse the existing topic-section plumbing.

items.title: Kids section
items.smarttube: Kids home rows (getKidsHomeObserve).
gaps: No kids home browse in the worker and no native folder

items.title: Sports section
items.smarttube: Sports rows.

items.smarttube: Live rows.

items.smarttube: Gaming rows.

items.smarttube: News rows (hidden in some regions).

items.title: My videos section
items.smarttube: Grid of the signed-in user's own uploads (getMyVideosObserve).
gaps: No 'my videos' library action in companion/innertube/library.mjs and no native folder under Accounts & library

items.title: Channels section (subscribed channels)
items.smarttube: List of subscribed channels with new-content marker, sorting by new content / name / last viewed, optional filter field, multi-grid with the selected channel's uploads, per-channel menu.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: root 'subscriptions' folder "Followed channels" lists locally followed channels as 'channel:<id>' folders
gaps: Only local follows are listed; the account's subscribed-channel list is not fetched
No new-content marker, no sorting options, no filter field
No channel menu (unsubscribe, mark channel as watched, pin)

items.title: Subscriptions section
items.smarttube: Grid of latest videos from subscriptions with paging.
items.notes: Live-account acceptance pending.

items.title: History section
items.smarttube: Account watch history grid with paging; local fallback when signed out.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: CATALOG_FOLDER('library:history', "YouTube history") and root 'history' ("Continue watching & history")

items.title: Blocked channels section
items.smarttube: Section listing blocked channels, shown only when at least one channel is blocked; selecting unblocks.

items.title: Playlists section
items.smarttube: User playlists (rows or grid), including Watch later and Liked, each openable and editable.
ps5_evidence: companion/innertube/worker.test.mjs: 'account playlists retain a separate navigation namespace'
items.notes: Rows-vs-grid style and custom playlist order are separate items (settings scope / extra.Menu.PlaylistOrder).

items.title: Notifications section
items.smarttube: Grid of account notifications (getNotificationItemsObserve) with hide-notification action.
gaps: No notifications fetch in the worker, no native folder, no hide action

items.title: Playback queue section
items.smarttube: Local playback queue shown as a section (most recent first).
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: root 'queue' folder "Play queue", ordered by queue_order; 'settings:clear-queue'

items.title: Settings section
items.smarttube: Settings grid as the last sidebar section (always enabled).
items.notes: Completeness of the settings themselves is audited elsewhere.

items.title: Pinned playlists / channels in the sidebar
items.smarttube: Any playlist or channel can be pinned as its own sidebar section (rows or grid), renamed, moved and unpinned.
gaps: No pin storage in the per-profile state
No pin/unpin action in 'account:menu:' / 'playlist:menu:'
No pinned folders emitted at the catalog root
items.notes: Favorites are per-video only and do not cover this.

items.title: Show/hide and reorder sidebar sections, boot section
items.smarttube: Each section can be enabled/disabled and moved up/down; the start (boot) section is selectable.
gaps: Root and Discover folder lists are hard-coded in local_catalog(); no per-profile visibility, order or start folder

items.title: Play video
items.smarttube: Menu entry that starts playback of the card.
ps5_evidence: README.md: Controls table 'D-pad / Cross: Focus / open or watch'
items.notes: Not a menu row; Cross on the card plays.

items.title: Play video incognito
items.smarttube: Plays the video without recording it in history or saved state.
gaps: No incognito flag: progress() always writes the record and watch_flush() reports to the account when history sync is on
items.notes: Implement as a 'local:video:<scope>:incognito:<id>' action that sets a one-shot flag consumed by resolve()/progress().

items.title: Play from start
items.smarttube: Resets the saved position to 0 and opens the video.
gaps: No action that clears resume_pos_sec before launching; only 'Remove from local history' (which also clears the watched marker)

items.title: Set / unset stream reminder
items.smarttube: For upcoming streams: toggles a reminder that starts playback when the stream goes live.
gaps: is_upcoming is produced by companion/innertube/library.mjs but not used natively; no reminder list, poller or menu entry

items.title: Add to / remove from most recent playlist
items.smarttube: One-tap add/remove for the last playlist used, with membership state.
gaps: Last-used playlist id/title is not remembered; menu has no shortcut row

items.title: Add to Watch later
items.smarttube: Adds the video to the account's Watch later playlist.
ps5_evidence: tests/test_native.c, companion/innertube/worker.test.mjs ('mutations use the requested stable IDs')

items.title: Add to / remove from playlist
items.smarttube: Dialog listing the user's playlists with checkboxes to add/remove the video.
items.notes: Two pickers with confirmation instead of one checkbox list; current membership is not shown in the add picker.

items.title: Create playlist
items.smarttube: Creates an empty playlist from the Playlists section menu.
ps5_evidence: companion/innertube/worker.test.mjs: 'playlist creation explicitly requests private visibility'

items.title: Rename playlist
items.smarttube: Renames an owned playlist from the Playlists section.

items.title: Add video to new playlist
items.smarttube: Creates a playlist containing the selected video.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: 'playlist:prompt:create:<video id>' ("Create playlist with this video")

items.title: Save playlist to library / remove playlist
items.smarttube: Saves someone else's playlist to the user's library, or deletes/removes a playlist from the Playlists section (with confirmation).
gaps: No Save playlist action for a foreign playlist (no like/save-playlist call in the worker)
playlist:menu is offered only for account playlists; saved foreign playlists cannot be removed distinctly from deletion

items.title: Playlist order
items.smarttube: Per-playlist sort order chooser (date added, popularity, published, manual...) in the Playlists section.
gaps: No per-playlist order preference and no sort parameter on the 'playlist' library action

items.title: Not interested
items.smarttube: On Home/Shorts cards: sends the feedback token (optionally a reason) and removes the card.
gaps: Home rows do not retain feedback tokens (only History does, in history_actions.mjs)
No 'not_interested' library action or native menu row
items.notes: The private-token retention pattern of history_actions.mjs can be reused.

items.title: Don't recommend channel
items.smarttube: On Home/Shorts cards: sends the second feedback token so the channel stops being recommended.
gaps: No feedback-token retention for Home rows; no action. Local Block channel hides rows on this PS5 only
items.notes: Small once extra.Menu.NotInterested exists.

items.title: Hide from Subscriptions / Notifications feed
items.smarttube: Removes a video from the Subscriptions feed (feedback token) or hides a notification.
gaps: No hide action for Subscriptions rows; Notifications section absent

items.title: Block / unblock channel
items.smarttube: Toggles a local channel block; blocked channels disappear from lists and a Blocked channels section appears.

items.title: Mark as watched
items.smarttube: Marks the video fully viewed locally and reports it to account history.
items.notes: Two separate rows (local / YouTube).

items.title: Add to / remove from playback queue
items.smarttube: Adds the video to the local queue, or removes it when already queued.
ps5_evidence: README.md: 'R2 / L2: Toggle queue / follow the video's channel'
items.notes: Bound to R2 rather than listed in the Touchpad menu.

items.title: Play next
items.smarttube: Inserts the video at the head of the queue.

items.title: Show playback queue
items.smarttube: Opens the queue dialog from the menu and plays the chosen entry.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: root 'queue' folder "Play queue"; g_browse_queue / queue_origin in resolve()
items.notes: Reachable as a root folder, not from the video menu.

items.title: Open channel (and channel uploads)
items.smarttube: From any video or channel card: opens the channel page; ChannelUploads menu offers the same.
gaps: 'account:menu:<id>' has no row that navigates to 'channel:<parent_id>' although the record stores the channel id (Record.item.parent_id) and 'channel:UC...' is a valid catalog id
Videos without a channel id (subscription feed rows) need a metadata lookup first
items.notes: Workaround today: L2 follows the channel, then open it under Followed channels.

items.title: Open playlist
items.smarttube: For a card that belongs to a playlist: opens that playlist as a grid.
gaps: No menu row to open the playlist of a video (playlist context is kept for playback only: tube_playback_playlist_context)
items.notes: Playlist cards themselves open as folders.

items.title: Subscribe / unsubscribe
items.smarttube: Toggles the channel subscription (syncing metadata first when the state is unknown).
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: g_account_actions 'subscribe' / 'unsubscribe' (channel=1); tube_toggle_subscription() for local follows
items.notes: Both rows are always listed; the current subscription state is not reflected in the label.

items.title: Exclude channel from SponsorBlock
items.smarttube: From a video/channel card: toggles the channel in the SponsorBlock exclusion list.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: settings "Excluded channels" ('Toggle the current channel or a followed channel'), "The excluded channel list is full."
gaps: Not available from the video actions menu; only the current channel and locally followed channels can be toggled in settings

items.title: Pin playlist / channel to sidebar
items.smarttube: Toggles a pinned sidebar section for the card's playlist or channel.
gaps: See extra.Section.Pinned

items.title: Open description
items.smarttube: Loads the video's metadata and shows the full description in a long-text dialog.
gaps: Only a 320-character overview is carried (companion/prosperotube/catalog.py item(): overview=text(description, 320)); no full-description fetch and no description row in 'account:menu:'
A long-text reader already exists for comments (g_comments[].content, L2/R2 scrolling) and could be reused

items.title: Open comments
items.smarttube: Opens the comments reader for the card (not for live/upcoming).

items.title: Share link
items.smarttube: Shares the video/channel/playlist URL (Android share sheet / copy).
gaps: No row that displays the youtu.be URL of the selected item
items.notes: On PS5 this reduces to showing the URL as text; pair it with the QR item.

items.title: Share link as QR code
items.smarttube: Shows a QR code of the video URL to open it on a phone.
gaps: No QR encoder or QR view in native/ or scripts/
items.notes: Encoder is host-testable; rendering needs a small image/RML element.

items.title: Share embed link
items.smarttube: Shares the youtube.com/embed/ URL of the video.
gaps: No share actions at all
items.notes: Trivial once ShareLink exists.

items.title: Select account
items.smarttube: Opens the account chooser from any menu.
items.notes: Reached through Accounts & library, not from the card menu.

items.title: Pause / resume watch history
items.smarttube: Pauses or resumes YouTube watch history on the account and stops local history recording.
gaps: The toggle only stops this client's reports; it does not pause watch history on the account, and local history keeps recording

items.title: Clear history
items.smarttube: Clears the whole account watch history (with confirmation) and refreshes the History section.
gaps: No account-level clear of YouTube history (worker has only per-video history_remove)
No confirmation step on the local clear was found

items.title: Return to background video
items.smarttube: When playback continues in the background while browsing, any menu offers a jump back to the player.
gaps: No background playback while browsing; opening the browser stops the player
items.notes: Needs player/browser coexistence in EVO and console validation.

items.title: Refresh section
items.smarttube: Section menu entry that reloads the current section and focuses its content.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: catalog() issues a new request and resets g_library_cursors whenever a folder is opened at page 0
gaps: No explicit refresh action for the folder being shown; the user must leave and re-enter

items.title: Move section up / down
items.smarttube: Reorders sidebar sections from the section menu.
gaps: See extra.Section.EnableAndOrder

items.title: Rename pinned section
items.smarttube: Renames a pinned (non-default) section.
gaps: Depends on extra.Section.Pinned

items.title: Unpin / hide section from sidebar
items.smarttube: Hides a default section or unpins a pinned one from the section menu.
gaps: See extra.Section.EnableAndOrder / extra.Section.Pinned

items.title: Mark all channels as watched / mark channel as watched
items.smarttube: Channels section: clears the new-content marker for all channels, or for one channel from its menu.
gaps: Depends on the account Channels section with new-content markers (extra.Section.Channels)

items.title: Check for updates (section menu)
items.smarttube: Section menu entry that starts the app update check.
gaps: No update check or self-update code in ProsperoTube
items.notes: Belongs with the About settings audit; the owner's boilerplate update-check kit applies.

items.title: Text search with paged results
items.smarttube: Submitting a query loads result groups; scrolling continues them; cards have the normal click / long-press behaviour.
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: search() / catalog() action 'search' with page
items.notes: Also accepts YouTube URLs and video:/channel:/playlist: forms.

items.title: Typing / commit behaviour
items.smarttube: Custom search bar: tags update while typing, results load on submit or tag click; options for keyboard auto-show, autofocus on results, typing corrections.
ps5_evidence: scripts/prepare_native.py: evo_keyboard_open("Search YouTube videos...") (PS5 system keyboard, search on confirm)
gaps: The query is not kept editable on a search screen: no visible search field to refine, and nothing happens while typing
No re-run of the last query without retyping
items.notes: Keyboard-related options (auto show, G20s fix, corrections) are Android-specific.

items.title: Search suggestions / autocomplete (incl. popular searches)
items.smarttube: Search tags provider returns completions for the typed text and popular/recent queries when empty; clicking a tag searches.
gaps: No suggestion endpoint in companion (companion/innertube/suggestions.mjs is related videos, not query completion)
No tag list in the native search flow

items.title: Search history
items.smarttube: Recent queries shown as tags; long-press removes one or clears all; setting to disable history.
gaps: Queries are not stored in the profile state; no recent-searches folder, no remove/clear actions
items.notes: Fits the per-profile JSON state and local_catalog() folders.

items.title: Voice search
items.smarttube: Voice recognition fills the query and searches; optional instant voice search on opening search.
items.notes: Physical microphone acceptance is still open; no instant-voice-on-open option. Needs the companion whisper service.

items.title: Filter: upload date
items.smarttube: Any / last hour / today / this week / this month / this year.
gaps: Search request carries only query and page; client.search(query) is called without filters; yt-dlp path uses plain ytsearch
items.notes: One shared change covers all five filter/sort items.

items.title: Filter: duration
items.smarttube: Any / under 4 min / 4-20 min / over 20 min.
gaps: No search options in the request or UI
items.notes: Part of the shared search-options change.

items.title: Filter: content type
items.smarttube: Any / video / channel / playlist / movie.
gaps: No search options; channel results are not normalised at all (library.mjs page() maps feed.videos and feed.playlists only)
items.notes: Needs a channel row normaliser that emits 'channel:<id>' folders.

items.title: Filter: features (Live, 4K, HDR)
items.smarttube: Multi-select feature filters.
gaps: No search options in the request or UI
items.notes: Part of the shared search-options change.

items.title: Sort results
items.smarttube: Relevance / upload date / view count / rating.
gaps: No search options in the request or UI
items.notes: Part of the shared search-options change.

items.title: Channel and playlist cards in results
items.smarttube: Results include channels (open channel page) and playlists (open grid).
ps5_evidence: companion/innertube/library.mjs: normalizePlaylist() -> is_folder rows in page()
gaps: Channel results are dropped
The yt-dlp guest path (catalog.py item()) keeps only 11-character video ids

items.title: Search and play first result
items.smarttube: startPlay(): runs the search and immediately plays the first video (used by external 'play X' requests).
gaps: No search-then-play entry, e.g. for phone or voice 'play ...' commands
items.notes: Low priority; mainly driven by Android intents.
